articles.summary: Sensata's Brake Force sensor directly measures clamping force within the brake caliper, providing the real-time feedback required for precise electromechanical brake (EMB) control. Supports improved braking performance, consistency, and safety through high-accuracy force measurement and closed-loop control at each wheel. Enables OEMs to accelerate adoption of brake-by-wire architectures designed for electrification, software-defined vehicles, and advanced driver assistance systems. Sensata Technologies (NYSE: ST), today announced its brake force sensors are now enabling electromechanical braking (EMB) systems in leading electric vehicles. This milestone marks a significant step in the transition from traditional hydraulic braking to fully electric, brake-by-wire systems, as vehicle OEMs increasingly adopt architectures designed for electrification, autonomy, and software-defined control. articles.summary: Sensata Technologies (NYSE: ST) today announced that it will disclose its Third Quarter 2026 financial results on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at or about 4:05 p.m. Eastern Time. Sensata will then host an earnings release conference call and webcast at 5:00 PM Eastern Time to discuss the results and business performance. The webcast and subsequent replay will be available on the investor relations page of the Company’s website at http://investors.sensata.com . Investors can also listen to the earnings call live via telephone by dialing 1-844-784-1726 or 1-412-380-7411 and referencing the Sensata Technologies Q3 2026 Financial Results Conference Call. A replay of the call will be available until November 3, 2026. To access the replay, dial 1-855-669-9658 or 1-412-317-0088 and enter confirmation code: 2813889.
